mcqs.question: In a two‑dimensional layer of identical atoms, which arrangement gives the highest packing efficiency?
mcqs.explanation: Hexagonal (triangular) packing allows each atom to be surrounded by six others, giving a packing efficiency of 0.907 (≈91%). Square packing gives only 0.785. Random and linear packings are less efficient. Hence the hexagonal arrangement is the most efficient in 2‑D.

mcqs.question: Which three‑dimensional close‑packed structure has the same packing efficiency as the hexagonal close‑packed (hcp) structure?
mcqs.explanation: Both hcp and cubic close‑packed (also called face‑centered cubic, FCC) have the same packing efficiency of 74 %. Simple cubic is 52 % and BCC is about 68 %. Therefore the structure with identical efficiency is the cubic close‑packed one.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes the hexagonal close‑packed (hcp) structure?

options.A: Each atom has 12 nearest neighbours and the layers repeat in an ABAB… pattern
options.B: Each atom has 8 nearest neighbours and the layers repeat in an ABCABC… pattern
options.C: Each atom has 6 nearest neighbours and the layers repeat in an AAA… pattern
options.D: Each atom has 12 nearest neighbours and the layers repeat in an ABCABC… pattern

mcqs.answer: Each atom has 12 nearest neighbours and the layers repeat in an ABAB… pattern
mcqs.explanation: In hcp, each atom contacts 12 others. The stacking sequence of close‑packed layers is ABAB…, distinguishing it from the ABCABC… sequence of cubic close packing. Options B, C, and D describe other structures.

mcqs.question: Which of the following metals most commonly crystallises in the cubic close‑packed (ccp) structure?
mcqs.explanation: Copper, along with many other transition metals such as Ag and Au, adopts the ccp (face‑centered cubic) structure. Sodium forms a body‑centered cubic lattice, alpha‑iron is BCC at room temperature, and calcium is also BCC.

mcqs.question: What is the packing efficiency of a cubic close‑packed (ccp) arrangement of identical spheres?
mcqs.explanation: In ccp (or FCC), each unit cell contains 4 whole spheres. The volume occupied by the spheres is 4 × (4/3)πr³ = (16/3)πr³. The cell edge a = 2√2 r, so cell volume = a³ = 16√2 r³. Packing efficiency = (16/3)πr³ / (16√2 r³) ≈ 0.74 or 74 %.

mcqs.question: A thin film of atoms is observed under a microscope. Each atom touches six neighboring atoms, forming a regular pattern. Which two‑dimensional packing arrangement does this describe?
mcqs.explanation: When each atom contacts six others in a plane, the arrangement is the hexagonal (triangular) close packing, which is the most efficient 2‑D packing. Square packing gives only four contacts per atom.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is FALSE regarding three‑dimensional cubic crystal structures?

options.A: Simple cubic has a packing efficiency of about 52 %
options.B: Body‑centered cubic has a packing efficiency of about 68 %
options.C: Cubic close‑packed (face‑centered cubic) has a packing efficiency of about 74 %
options.D: All cubic crystal structures have the same packing efficiency

mcqs.answer: All cubic crystal structures have the same packing efficiency
mcqs.explanation: The three cubic lattices differ: simple cubic ≈52 %, BCC ≈68 %, and ccp/FCC ≈74 %. Therefore the statement that all cubic structures share the same efficiency is incorrect.

mcqs.question: A crystal shows a layer‑stacking sequence ABAB… and each atom has 12 nearest neighbours. Which structure does it correspond to?
mcqs.explanation: The ABAB… stacking and 12 nearest neighbours are characteristic of the hcp structure. FCC (ccp) follows an ABCABC… sequence, while simple cubic and BCC have different neighbour counts.
